video:video.video:title: Vikram Vedha
video:video.video:description: Vikram Vedha is a neo-noir action thriller exploring morality and the gray areas between good and evil

video:video.video:title: Pushpa: The Rise
video:video.video:description: Pushpa: The Rise is a 2021 Telugu-language action drama film that follows the rise of a daily wage laborer, Pushpa Raj, as he becomes a powerful figure in the red sandalwood smuggling world, featuring Allu Arjun in the lead role.

video:video.video:title: Dhurandhar
video:video.video:description: Dhurandhar is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language spy action thriller film directed by Aditya Dhar, featuring a star-studded cast including Ranveer Singh and Akshaye Khanna.

video:video.video:title: Avengers : Doomsday
video:video.video:description: Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe film set for release on December 18, 2026, directed by the Russo Brothers.

video:video.video:title: HIT the third Case
video:video.video:description: HIT: The Third Case is an intense crime thriller that dives deep into the darkest corners of the human mind.

video:video.video:title: Loki
video:video.video:description: Loki is a Marvel Cinematic Universe series that follows the God of Mischief, Loki, as he navigates time and identity after the events of "Avengers: Endgame."

video:video.video:title: Ikkis
video:video.video:description: Ikkis is a 2026 Hindi biographical war drama depicting the life of Second Lieutenant Arun Khetarpal, starring Agastya Nanda in his debut and marking Dharmendra’s final film.

video:video.video:title: Animal
video:video.video:description: Animal is a Hindi-language action-crime drama directed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga. The story revolves around Ranvijay Singh, the hardened son of a powerful industrialist, who returns home after years abroad. His strained relationship with his father, Balbir Singh, unfolds against a violent backdrop of gang wars and betrayal. The film explores themes of family, revenge, and the psychological toll of violence.

video:video.video:title: Stree
video:video.video:description: A supernatural horror-comedy about a mysterious female entity known as 'Stree' that haunts a small town. Rajkummar Rao and Shraddha Kapoor star in this innovative Bollywood thriller that blends folklore with modern storytelling.

video:video.video:title: KGF: Chapter 1
video:video.video:description: An action-crime film that follows a mysterious man who rises from poverty to become a powerful figure in a gold mining region. This Kannada action blockbuster was dubbed in Hindi and became a massive pan-Indian hit.

video:video.video:title: Ra. One
video:video.video:description: A groundbreaking sci-fi action film where a video game villain comes to life. Shah Rukh Khan stars in this ambitious Bollywood sci-fi thriller featuring cutting-edge visual effects and digital technology.

video:video.video:title: Uri : The Surgical Strike
video:video.video:description: Uri: The Surgical Strike is a 2019 Indian Hindi-language war action film that dramatizes India’s retaliatory strike against militants following the 2016 Uri attack, starring Vicky Kaushal and directed by Aditya Dhar.

video:video.video:title: CHHICHHORE
video:video.video:description: Chhichhore revolves around a group of college friends who reunite years later when one of them, Anirudh "Anni" Pathak, and Maya's son, Raghav, attempts suicide after failing an entrance exam.

video:video.video:title: IT: Welcome to Derry
video:video.video:description: IT: Welcome to Derry explores strange occurrences and disappearances in the town of Derry, where a military family moves to experience a "normal" life, only to uncover a dark history of missing children and unsolved mysteries

video:video.video:title: Jujutsu Kaisen
video:video.video:description: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, titled "The Culling Game Part 1," premiered on January 8, 2026, and is currently airing weekly episodes on Crunchyroll and MBS/TBS in Japan.

video:video.video:title: Doraemon in Nobita's Little Space War
video:video.video:description: In "Nobita's Little Space War," Doraemon plays a central role by helping Nobita and friends protect the tiny alien Papi using his futuristic gadgets and clever strategies.

video:video.video:title: Avengers: Infinity War
video:video.video:description: Avengers: Infinity War is a 2018 Marvel superhero film where the Avengers and Guardians of the Galaxy unite to stop Thanos from collecting all six Infinity Stones and wiping out half of all life in the universe.

video:video.video:title: Kalki 2898 AD
video:video.video:description: "Kalki 2898 AD" is a 2024 Indian epic science fiction film blending Hindu mythology with a dystopian future, centered around the protection of Kalki, Vishnu’s final incarnation.

video:video.video:title: Panchayat
video:video.video:description: Presenting Panchayat Official Trailer 2020, created by TVF, the makers of Hostel Daze & Kota Factory starring Jitendra Kumar aka Jeetu Bhaiya, Biswapati Sarkar in the leading roles. Panchayat is a comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh.

video:video.video:title: O Romeo
video:video.video:description: O'Romeo (2026) is a romantic action-drama directed by Vishal Bhardwaj based on S. Hussain Zaidi's book *Mafia Queens of Mumbai*. It follows Ustara (Shahid Kapoor), a feared hitman in 1990s Mumbai who falls for a vengeful widow, Afsha (Triptii Dimri), and helps her take on a crime lord. The film is a "gritty" but sometimes melodramatic mix of action and romance, with performances by Nana Patekar and Avinash Tiwary.

video:video.video:title: Tere Ishk Mein
video:video.video:description: A psychology student attempts to rehabilitate a volatile young man, before evolving into a doomed romance.

video:video.video:title: Mirzapur
video:video.video:description: The iron-fisted Akhandanand Tripathi is a millionaire carpet exporter and the mafia don of Mirzapur. His son, Munna, is an unworthy, power-hungry heir who will stop at nothing to inherit his father's legacy. An incident at a wedding procession forces him to cross paths with Ramakant Pandit, an upstanding lawyer, and his sons, Guddu and Bablu. It snowballs into a game of ambition, power and greed that threatens the fabric of this lawless city.

video:video.video:title: Moon Knight
video:video.video:description: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

video:video.video:title: The Founder
video:video.video:description: The true story of how Ray Kroc, a salesman from Illinois, met Mac and Dick McDonald, who were running a burger operation in 1950s Southern California. Kroc was impressed by the brothers’ speedy system of making the food and saw franchise potential. He maneuvered himself into a position to be able to pull the company from the brothers and create a billion-dollar empire.

video:video.video:title: Blackmail
video:video.video:description: When Dev finds about his wife's affair, he starts blackmailing her and her lover but the blackmail game backfires on him.

video:video.video:title: Hindi Medium
video:video.video:description: Mita and Raj Batra, an affluent couple from Delhi’s Chandni Chowk, are grappling with getting their daughter admission into an English medium school. But there is one big problem. Their zubaan is Hindi, and the elitist snobs won’t let the Hindi speaking hoi-polloi fit in.

video:video.video:title: Jab We Met
video:video.video:description: A depressed wealthy businessman and a spunky carefree young woman embark on an unexpected journey that changes their lives.

video:video.video:title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
video:video.video:description: NRI Siddharth Chaturvedi and his wife Avni return to Siddharth's family's ancestral Varanasi palace while disregarding warnings of a curse and paranormal phenomena. Soon enough, inexplicable events begin occuring, which forces Siddharth to consult the eccentric psychiatrist Aditya Shrivastav to help solve the mystery.

video:video.video:title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
video:video.video:description: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.
1920, India. After forsaking his family and religion, a husband finds his wife is possessed by a spirit.

Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder Backdrop

video:video.video:title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
video:video.video:description: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

image:image.image:title: Kurukshetra: The Great War of Mahabharata Poster
Kurukshetra: The Great War of Mahabharata Backdrop

video:video.video:title: Kurukshetra: The Great War of Mahabharata
video:video.video:description: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.

video:video.video:title: Sanjay
video:video.video:description: When diplomatic talks between the feuding Pandavas and Kauravas fall apart, the messenger Sanjay must deliver difficult news — war is near.

video:video.video:title: Vishwaroop
video:video.video:description: As the battle begins, Lord Krishn reveals the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita through divine radiance as he guides a torn Arjun towards fulfilling his duty.

video:video.video:title: Bhishm
video:video.video:description: In the story of Bhishm, Krishn recalls the abduction of Princess Amba. But her transformation into Shikhandi will lead to death on the battlefield.

video:video.video:title: Dronacharya
video:video.video:description: Dronacharya rises to the role of commander of the Kauravas. But when his plan to stop Yudhishthir's coronation fails, he makes a deadly vow.

video:video.video:title: Abhimanyu
video:video.video:description: Abhimanyu, the Pandava prince, steps onto the battlefield to combat Dronacharya's complex assault. But tragedy occurs at the hands of the Kauravas.

video:video.video:title: Jayadrath
video:video.video:description: The grieving Pandavas cast blame for their loss. When Jayadrath is mentioned, Draupadi has disturbing memories. Enraged, Arjun prepares to fight.

video:video.video:title: Arjun
video:video.video:description: With Krishn's cosmic aid, Arjun seeks revenge from Jayadrath, while attempting to counter an age-old curse.

video:video.video:title: Ghatotkach
video:video.video:description: A nighttime battle rages, led by Ghatotkach, Bheem's half-demon son. For the Kauravas, one choice remains — a weapon reserved to fight Arjun.

video:video.video:title: Yudhisthir
video:video.video:description: After an injury sidelines him, honorable Yudhishthir returns to a fateful crossroads — must he uphold truth or surrender to falsehood?

video:video.video:title: Kripacharya
video:video.video:description: Kripacharya hosts a unique duel between Ashwatthama and Karn to determine the next commander, but rage and violence soon follow.

video:video.video:title: Kunti
video:video.video:description: As he prepares to take on leadership, Karn reflects on his relationship with his birth mother, Kunti, and his vow to defeat Arjun.

video:video.video:title: Dushasan
video:video.video:description: Haunted by Draupadi's humiliation, Bheem sets out to target Dushasan in a brutal attack for revenge.

video:video.video:title: Karn
video:video.video:description: To defeat Arjun, Karn requests the skilled rider Shalya to take him into battle. But he soon faces the charioteer's ridicule and an old curse.

video:video.video:title: Duryodhan
video:video.video:description: Duryodhan flees the battlefield after Shalya's death, finding a hideout within Lake Dwaipayana as the Pandavas search for him.

video:video.video:title: Bheem
video:video.video:description: Bheem and Duryodhan finally face each other in war, while Krishn and Lord Balaram argue over incidents of unlawful fighting on both sides.

video:video.video:title: Ashwatthama
video:video.video:description: Driven by wrath, Ashwatthama leads a devastating massacre. But when his vengeance threatens the world, Krishn steps in to stop him.

video:video.video:title: Stree Parv
video:video.video:description: A grief-stricken Gandhari meets Krishn — and leaves him with an ominous curse. The Pandava women mourn their losses in Kurukshetra.

video:video.video:title: Krishn
video:video.video:description: After Yudhishthir's coronation, Krishn leaves for Dwarka, carrying reminders of Gandhari's words as one family collapses and another rises.

video:video.video:title: Avengers: Endgame
video:video.video:description: Avengers: Endgame is a superhero film that serves as the culmination of the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Infinity Saga.

video:video.video:title: Dune: Part Two
video:video.video:description: Dune: Part Two" continues the saga of Frank Herbert's celebrated novel Dune. The film, directed by Denis Villeneuve, is the highly anticipated follow-up to the six-time Academy Award-winning 2021 film "Dune."

video:video.video:title: Inception
video:video.video:description: Inception (2010) is a science fiction thriller directed by Christopher Nolan . The movie centers on Dom Cobb (Leonardo DiCaprio), a specialist in "subconscious security".

video:video.video:title: Game of Thrones
video:video.video:description: Game of Thrones is an HBO fantasy series known for its complex characters, political intrigue, and supernatural threats. The show revolves around noble families battling for control of the Iron Throne in the fictional continents of Westeros and Essos.

video:video.video:title: Stranger Things
video:video.video:description: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

video:video.video:title: Money Heist
video:video.video:description: Money Heist is a Spanish crime-drama series created by Álex Pina. The story follows a criminal mastermind known as The Professor, who recruits eight skilled individuals to carry out an ambitious plan: infiltrate the Royal Mint of Spain and print billions of euros while holding hostages inside. Each member adopts a city name as their alias—Tokyo, Berlin, Nairobi, Rio, Denver, Moscow, Helsinki, and Oslo.
